changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant 'SummaC benchmark' since SummaC already covers the six datasets. Normalized 'summaries' to 'Summaries'. The paper evaluates factual consistency of text summarization outputs but does not evaluate specific summarization models.

Normalized metric names to standard capitalization: QAFactEval (following paper's naming), BERTScore-FFCI, and QAFactEval-NLI. All metrics are correctly extracted as they are used to evaluate factual consistency of summaries.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators. The models mentioned (BERT, RoBERTa, BART, T5, Electra) are used as components in the evaluation pipelines, not as post-hoc judges.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. It relies exclusively on existing benchmarks with human annotations (SummaC, FRANK, etc.) but does not collect new human judgments.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating factual consistency metrics for text summarization. It uses automatic metrics to evaluate summary quality but conducts no new human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate, requiring only minor normalization of metric names.
